description:
How much each migrant community earns: weekly personal income bands by region of birth (nine world regions), in every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,800 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few residents for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/income-by-birthplace`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**
